description: This file defines an interface 'PersistenceStreamConfig' which specifies configuration settings related to persistence streams, including a method to get the maximum bulk size for write operations and an enumeration for default configuration values.

classes.name: PersistenceStreamConfig
classes.description: An interface that extends StreamStageConfig, providing a method to get the maximum bulk size for persistence operations.

classes.name: PersistenceStreamConfigEnum.PersistenceStreamConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue, defining default configuration values such as 'MAX_BULK_SIZE' with a default value of 250.

methods.name: getMaxBulkSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of write operations to perform in one bulk.
